title: they said “come to the cabaret” and I said ‘YES’ #cabaretbway #evanob...
transcript: I am going to be at cabaret every single day Orville Peck and Eva Noblezada are joining the cast of Cabaret starting March 31st Orville Peck as the Emcee Eva Noblezada as Sally Bowles I can't handle this it's perfect Eva obviously you know from Miss Saigon and HadesTown currently in The Great Gatsby about to leave to go to HadesTown in London and now she's going to be Sally Bowles which is the best casting I've ever heard Eva has said before publicly that Sally Bowles is a dream role for her and I just it's so good I'm just picturing her singing ‘don't tell Mama’ ‘mein herr’ it's gonna be so good it is an absolutely perfect role for her now I will be honest I don't really know Orville Peck that well I know that he is a country music artist known for wearing a mask I was doing some research and he actually grew up doing musical theater he's a big fan of cabaret he called the emcee a dream role since he was a kid he apparently teased that he will not be wearing his mask in cabaret people will have to buy a ticket to find out oh I kinda love that I really just over this cabaret just keeps nailing that casting and it's a can’t miss eva noblezada sally bowles
